title: Find the Width of Columns of a Grid
statement: For each column, return the maximum number of characters needed to write any value in that column.
approach_name: Find the maximum decimal string length in each column
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Width of Columns of a Grid
statement: For each column, return the maximum number of characters needed to write any value in that column.
approach_name: Find the maximum decimal string length in each column
code: import java.util.*; class Solution { public int[] findColumnWidth(int[][] grid){int[] a=new int[grid[0].length];for(int j=0;j<a.length;j++)for(int[] r:grid)a[j]=Math.max(a[j],Integer.toString(r[j]).length());return a;} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Score of All Prefixes of an Array
statement: For each prefix, sum each element plus the maximum element seen so far.
approach_name: Track prefix maximum and running sum of prefix scores
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Score of All Prefixes of an Array
statement: For each prefix, sum each element plus the maximum element seen so far.
approach_name: Track prefix maximum and running sum of prefix scores
code: class Solution { public long[] findPrefixScore(int[] nums){long[] a=new long[nums.length];int m=0;long s=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){m=Math.max(m,nums[i]);s+=(long)m+nums[i];a[i]=s;}return a;} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Row With Maximum Ones
statement: Return the index of the row with the most ones and that count; ties go to the smallest row index.
approach_name: Count ones per row and keep the earliest maximum
code: class Solution { public int[] rowAndMaximumOnes(int[][] mat){int bi=0,bc=-1;for(int i=0;i<mat.length;i++){int c=0;for(int x:mat[i])c+=x;if(c>bc){bc=c;bi=i;}}return new int[]{bi,bc};} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Maximum Divisibility Score
statement: Choose the divisor that divides the most nums values; break ties by choosing the smallest divisor.
approach_name: Count divisible values for each candidate divisor
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Maximum Divisibility Score
statement: Choose the divisor that divides the most nums values; break ties by choosing the smallest divisor.
approach_name: Count divisible values for each candidate divisor
code: class Solution { public int maxDivScore(int[] nums,int[] divisors){int ans=divisors[0],best=-1;for(int d:divisors){int c=0;for(int x:nums)if(x%d==0)c++;if(c>best||(c==best&&d<ans)){best=c;ans=d;}}return ans;} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Sum Multiples
statement: Return the sum of all positive integers up to n divisible by 3, 5, or 7.
approach_name: Sum numbers divisible by 3, 5, or 7
code:
class Solution:
 def sumOfMultiples(self, n): return sum(x for x in range(1,n+1) if x%3==0 or x%5==0 or x%7==0)
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Sum Multiples
statement: Return the sum of all positive integers up to n divisible by 3, 5, or 7.
approach_name: Sum numbers divisible by 3, 5, or 7
code: class Solution { public int sumOfMultiples(int n){int s=0;for(int x=1;x<=n;x++)if(x%3==0||x%5==0||x%7==0)s+=x;return s;} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Maximum Sum With Exactly K Elements
statement: Choose the largest value k times, increasing it by one after each choice; return the sum of chosen values.
approach_name: Always choose and increment the current maximum
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Maximum Sum With Exactly K Elements
statement: Choose the largest value k times, increasing it by one after each choice; return the sum of chosen values.
approach_name: Always choose and increment the current maximum
code: class Solution { public int maximizeSum(int[] nums,int k){int m=0;for(int x:nums)m=Math.max(m,x);return k*m+k*(k-1)/2;} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Prefix Common Array of Two Arrays
statement: For each index, return how many values have appeared in both prefixes of A and B.
approach_name: Count seen values from both prefixes
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Prefix Common Array of Two Arrays
statement: For each index, return how many values have appeared in both prefixes of A and B.
approach_name: Count seen values from both prefixes
code: import java.util.*; class Solution { public int[] findThePrefixCommonArray(int[] A,int[] B){Set<Integer>a=new HashSet<>(),b=new HashSet<>();int[] out=new int[A.length];for(int i=0;i<A.length;i++){a.add(A[i]);b.add(B[i]);int c=0;for(int x:a)if(b.contains(x))c++;out[i]=c;}return out;} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Determine the Winner of a Bowling Game
statement: Score each roll as its pins plus a double bonus when a strike occurred in either of the preceding two turns; return 1, 2, or 0 for a tie.
approach_name: Double a roll when either of the previous two rolls was a strike
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Determine the Winner of a Bowling Game
statement: Score each roll as its pins plus a double bonus when a strike occurred in either of the preceding two turns; return 1, 2, or 0 for a tie.
approach_name: Double a roll when either of the previous two rolls was a strike
code: class Solution { public int isWinner(int[] player1,int[] player2){int a=score(player1),b=score(player2);return a>b?1:b>a?2:0;} private int score(int[] a){int s=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){boolean bonus=false;for(int j=Math.max(0,i-2);j<i;j++)if(a[j]==10)bonus=true;s+=a[i]*(bonus?2:1);}return s;} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Distinct Difference Array
statement: At each index, return the number of distinct values in the prefix through that index minus the number of distinct values in the suffix after it.
approach_name: Subtract distinct suffix count from distinct prefix count
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.

title: Find the Distinct Difference Array
statement: At each index, return the number of distinct values in the prefix through that index minus the number of distinct values in the suffix after it.
approach_name: Subtract distinct suffix count from distinct prefix count
code: import java.util.*; class Solution { public int[] distinctDifferenceArray(int[] nums){int n=nums.length;int[] out=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){Set<Integer>a=new HashSet<>(),b=new HashSet<>();for(int j=0;j<=i;j++)a.add(nums[j]);for(int j=i+1;j<n;j++)b.add(nums[j]);out[i]=a.size()-b.size();}return out;} }
time_complexity: See algorithm; O(n) for single-pass tasks and O(n²) for direct distinct-count scans.
space_complexity: O(n) or O(m) auxiliary space depending on the input.
